criteria.ac: A `## Scenarios` scenario embedding a plain fenced block with an internal blank line classifies as exactly one `scenario` criterion under `faff dod classify` (no phantom `prose` fragment from inside the fence).
criteria.verified: verified: `node plugin/skills/faff/bin/faff dod --selftest` passes — dodSelftest check "a plain fenced scenario with an internal blank line is one scenario criterion"

criteria.ac: Inside a fence, blank/list/italic/blockquote lines do not open or close a unit; every such line is continuation of the current unit.
criteria.verified: verified: `node plugin/skills/faff/bin/faff dod --selftest` passes — dodSelftest check "a fenced example with a `- ` list line does not fragment the scenario"

criteria.ac: An in-fence `Given` line still starts a new unit, so `dodClassify`'s scenario count equals `parseScenarios`'s count for a spec with multiple `Given` blocks inside one fence (parseScenarios parity).
criteria.verified: verified: `node plugin/skills/faff/bin/faff dod --selftest` passes — dodSelftest check "two Given blocks in one fence form two scenario criteria == parseScenarios == 2"

criteria.ac: A `holdout`/`integration`-marked fence-open closes any unit opened outside the fence, so the fence's content is its own `holdout`/`integration`-tagged unit; the preceding scenario stays visible (holdoutRemovalSpans parity).
criteria.verified: verified: `node plugin/skills/faff/bin/faff dod --selftest` passes — dodSelftest check "a mid-unit holdout fence is its own holdout:true unit, preceding scenario stays visible"

criteria.ac: A fenced example containing a `- ` list line does not fragment the scenario.
criteria.verified: verified: `node plugin/skills/faff/bin/faff dod --selftest` passes — dodSelftest check "a fenced example with a `- ` list line does not fragment the scenario"

criteria.ac: A standalone fenced block with no preceding `Given` forms a single unit classed by its own text.
criteria.verified: verified: `node plugin/skills/faff/bin/faff dod --selftest` passes — dodSelftest check "a standalone fenced block with no preceding Given forms one unit classed by its own text"

criteria.ac: An unterminated fence emits the `dod classify: unterminated fence …` stderr advisory and flushes one trailing unit without error; `Given` blocks before and after the stray fence still count.
criteria.verified: verified: `node plugin/skills/faff/bin/faff dod --selftest` passes — dodSelftest check "an unterminated fence emits the stderr advisory"

criteria.ac: Out-of-fence classification is byte-for-byte unchanged: the existing `dodSelftest` cases (FAFF-306 heading-boundary, FAFF-275 holdout, numbered-heading) all still pass.
criteria.verified: verified: `node plugin/skills/faff/bin/faff dod --selftest` passes — dodSelftest check "out-of-fence selftest cases (FAFF-306/FAFF-275/numbered) all still pass"

criteria.ac: `faff dod split --view builder` over a spec with a mid-unit `holdout` fenced scenario yields the full classified set minus exactly the holdout unit (the FAFF-275 invariant), with no preceding visible scenario text removed.
criteria.verified: verified: `node plugin/skills/faff/bin/faff dod --selftest` passes — dodSelftest check "builder view == full minus the holdout unit (no preceding scenario text removed)"

criteria.ac: `dodSelftest` gains the four cases named in §6 (plain-blank-line, two-Given-in-fence with `parseScenarios` equality, mid-unit holdout with split parity, unterminated-fence advisory). `faff dod --selftest` passes.
criteria.verified: verified: `node plugin/skills/faff/bin/faff dod --selftest` passes — dodSelftest check "dodSelftest gains the four FAFF-1205 cases; faff dod --selftest passes"
